# How the credit review works

Recommender credit-review-v0.1, all in code: the model never scores a shop.

* Window: the last 56 days of the book.
* At least 4 verified payments before any support.
* On time 85% or better can support a rise; under 60% counts against it.
* An invoice more than 14 days overdue counts against it.
* Shelf photo: a count over 1.5x what the book explains (or 6+ pieces) is flagged for the owner, never trusted alone.

The owner sets every limit. A shop never hears its score or reasons.
